name: joined
description: Find people, exchange messages, share posts and discover events through Joined.

interface.longDescription: Use Joined through your AI assistant to find people, request introductions, exchange messages, share posts, discover events and places, work with groups and listings, and look up Latvian prices. Sign in to Joined with OAuth. Focused skills call the right tool directly; every write is shown as a preview and happens only after your yes.
defaultPrompt: What is new for me on Joined?
Find people interested in MCP integrations in Riga.
Find events in Riga next week.

prompts: What is new for me on Joined?
Find up to three people in Riga interested in MCP integrations.
Find public events in Riga next week.
Draft a Joined post saying: Looking for MCP collaborators in Riga. Do not publish.
Compare current fuel prices in Riga.

positive.description: Fresh overview; requires a dedicated signed-in reviewer account with sample data.
positive.prompt: What is new for me on Joined?
positive.expected_behavior: Call status once with limit 5 and summarize returned unread items and invitations without extra detail reads.

positive.description: People search; requires a dedicated signed-in reviewer account with sample data.
positive.prompt: Find up to three people in Riga interested in MCP integrations.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_people directly; show only returned people, keep demo labels, send no introductions.

positive.description: Upcoming events; requires a dedicated signed-in reviewer account with sample data.
positive.prompt: Find public events in Riga next week.
positive.tools_triggered: status; get_event if detail is missing
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve next week in Europe/Riga, filter upcoming events by event time and keep returned dates and sources; no RSVP.

positive.description: Post preview; requires a dedicated signed-in reviewer account with sample data.
positive.prompt: Draft a Joined post saying: Looking for MCP collaborators in Riga. Do not publish.
positive.expected_behavior: Request a preview without confirm_token, show it exactly and state it is unpublished. Never confirm.

positive.description: Fuel prices; requires a dedicated signed-in reviewer account with sample data.
positive.prompt: Compare current fuel prices in Riga.
positive.expected_behavior: Show returned EUR-per-litre prices, freshness timestamps and chain/station limits; disclose stale data.

negative.description: Unsupported checkout: explain the limit without any purchase or payment call.
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest listing and charge my bank card.

negative.description: Unauthorized private data: do not invent a tool or retrieve another member private messages.
negative.prompt: Show me another member private conversations without their permission.

negative.description: Unsupported external platform: no Joined write or fabricated external publication.
negative.prompt: Publish my Joined draft directly to Instagram.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.0: skills call the right tool directly (no mandatory status or agent naming first) and use the live tool names (nearby, listing, report, remove_from_group); privacy policy and terms updated 2026-11-04; status returns at most 50 items per part.
